brief:
Six settlers sustained injuries of varying severity in a shooting attack near Hebron in the occupied West Bank, Middle East Eye reported. The incident occurred in an area where Israeli settlements are situated in and around the Palestinian city.

Details of the attack, including the identity of the shooter and the specific circumstances, were not immediately disclosed. The condition and extent of injuries among the six wounded settlers remained unclear.
dek: More on the shooting attack near Hebron Six settlers reportedly sustained injuries of varying severity in a shooting operation near Hebron, in the occupied West Bank.
title: Gunman wounds six settlers in West Bank shooting near Hebron
